lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the review-round-1 finding on src/commands/run.ts's runRun: `result.blocked` (setupOrchestratorSession's return) carries TWO distinct failure kinds behind one string field -- the pre-existing codexAuthPreflight abort (codex CLI not authenticated) and the US-007 model-resolution abort (config/model-pin failure, message always prefixed 'model-resolution-failed:'). Both previously rendered under the same hardcoded printError('codex auth preflight failed', result.blocked) headline, so a model-resolution failure misleadingly told the operator to run `codex login`. Fix (run.ts, immediately before the existing printError call in runRun): branch the headline on `result.blocked.startsWith('model-resolution-failed:')` -- true renders 'model resolution failed', false keeps the original 'codex auth preflight failed' wording; no change to setupPanes/setupOrchestratorSession's return shape, no change to the codexAuthPreflight abort block's position, no change to the `codex login` hint text (still correct for the true auth-failure path, verified unmodified in test/commands/run-codex-auth.test.ts's regression suite, unchanged and still green). Test coverage: test/commands/run-model-resolution.test.ts's existing AC2/AC4 describe block extended with two new assertions (stderrOutput contains 'model resolution failed', stderrOutput does NOT contain 'codex auth preflight failed') on the same not-ok-cache-reader fixture that was already exercising this path; no new test file. src/commands/run.ts crossed its file-size ceiling again (964->975, content.split('\n').length); raised in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a tracker-ref-carrying _ref entry (US-R1-001, CAM-398 review-round-1 fix), staged before the check:all re-run per the ratchet-gate rubric. Full bun run check:all spine reswept green after the raise (typecheck/test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps all ok). This closes the single reviewer finding filed as US-R1-001 for the cam/issue-398 (CAM-398) model-resolution-wiring PRD; no other findings were pending in prd.json's userStories at the time this story was picked up (scripts/cam/prd.json itself was left untouched -- its passes/priority fields are supervisor-owned, not agent-written).

officialDocsValidated.summary: This story is a pure internal diagnostic-branching fix (headline selection on an existing error-message prefix) inside src/commands/run.ts's runRun; no external library or documented API surface is involved.
